note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1964: sixteen contests at the close of nominations, fifteen after the withdrawal of Bernard Murphy in Belleek, polled 4 June 1964. Polled 4 June 1964, counted 5 June. McArdle was the sitting member. The printed poll (406) is four more than the votes and spoilt paper (402).
